name: reference-cells
title: Reference cells
question: The standing grid: three lifecycle stages at three TVLs.
note: Stage profiles (fund size, cadence, proposal size, tier-2 share, approvers, return, win rate) are MODELLING ASSUMPTIONS invented for this simulation -- they are in assumptions.json and are the first thing to argue about. The ratios (fee as % of gross, stake per $1 of coverage) are far more robust than the absolute dollars, which scale linearly in TVL anyway.
